name: marp-cli
description: Markdown presentation ecosystem CLI - converts Markdown slides to PDF, PowerPoint, HTML with themes and speaker notes

marp.description: Convert Markdown presentations to PDF, PPTX, HTML with syntax highlighting, themes, and speaker notes support
marp.usage:
marp slides.md # Preview in browser
marp slides.md -o slides.pdf # Export to PDF
marp slides.md -o slides.pptx # Export to PowerPoint
marp slides.md -o slides.html # Export to standalone HTML
marp slides.md --theme gaia # Use built-in theme
marp --allow-local-files slides.md -o slides.pdf # Include local images
